title: cost-opt-autotune-defaults-batching-caching-quant-uecon-tooling
author: Priya Patel
description: Motivation: reduce per-token unit cost for common LLM workloads by providing safe, production-ready defaults for batching, prefix/KV caching and quantization profiles, plus visibility into unit economics. Changes bundled here are a follow-up to the cost-optimization initiative and aim to make autotune the default behavior for new deployments while preserving opt-out for latency-sensitive routes; Changes: (1) runtime: introduce 'autotune_defaults' config that adjusts target batch sizes, max latency SLOs for continuous batching, and cache retention heuristics based on model family and observed seq-length distribution; (2) quant: add curated quantization profiles (int8 dynamic, q4_0/q4_1 presets) with compatibility checks and runtime fallback to full-precision for failure cases; (3) tooling: extend the unit-econ dashboard export to include per-route cost-per-1k-tokens and model-variant delta estimates; (4) APIs: add new admin endpoints to preview autotune suggestions and to pin recommended profiles; Testing: unit + integration tests added for batcher heuristics, kv-cache TTL behavior, quant fallback logic, and end-to-end instrumentation for the UEcon dashboard; perf canary run against internal 'synth-chat' workload showed ~28% cost reduction for mid-length requests with median latency increase <6ms; Rollout: feature-flagged under 'autotune_defaults.v1' with canary rollout to 10% of traffic for one week before global rollout; Runbook updated and alert rules for regressions added. Related work: ENG-4821, ENG-4992.

review_thread: Ethan Brooks: Nice consolidation — can we make sure the autotune defaults are conservative for high-p99 latency routes?
Priya Patel: Agree, added max_latency cap per route and opt-out flag; documented behavior in the rollout guide.
María Gomez: Quant profiles look good but add a CI gate for kernel compatibility. Observed one failure on older A100 driver in my local run.
Priya Patel: Added compatibility checks and a runtime fallback to fp16 for mismatched kernels; updated tests to cover the failure path.
Liam O'Connor: UEcon export is extremely helpful — request one more column for 'estimate_confidence' to indicate sample variance.
Priya Patel: Added estimate_confidence and threshold-based alerts; will watch canary metrics next 48h.
Ethan Brooks: Approving after addressing conservative defaults and tests. 👍
